news.title: A painless punch with a microneedle patch could detect kidney disease earlier
news.summary_en: New research from the lab of WashU McKelvey Engineering’s Srikanth Singamaneni shows the early success of a microneedle patch that can be applied on the skin to capture biomarkers of kidney injury. It may one day support home or point-of-care monitoring.

news.title: FDA clears blood test to aid evaluation for Alzheimer’s disease
news.summary_en: The biomarker test, called PrecivityAD2, was developed from technology invented at WashU Medicine by Randall J. Bateman, MD, and David M. Holtzman, MD.

news.title: Housing may shape death risks for low-income older renters
news.summary_en: For low-income older adults, where they live may affect how long they live, according to new research from Washington University in St. Louis.
